audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields claim Black Shield (E) 'only stops CC, not damage' and that Lux's E/auto/R 'still chunk through it' or a shielded carry 'takes full damage.' The kit text says the opposite: Black Shield 'absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.'
audit.why: enemyKit.E.text is explicit that the shield blocks both damage and CC until its HP is used up. The page's repeated claim that damage passes through it is a fabricated mechanic that would make a reader waste poke into a shield instead of breaking it first.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[2], mid, spikes[2].text, late, and wants.you[1] to say the shield must be broken (with poke) before a root/burst combo lands, matching Riot's text.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side all read the placeholder 'Skill' while content win[0..6] already say 'Lux' for every stage — the two layers disagree on who wins each row.
audit.why: THE CHART RULE requires full .side and content win[N] to name the same side. win[N] is already correct (matches packet.levelChart: Lux all 7 rows), so only .side needs to move — no win[N] edit since it isn't changing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown numbers (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and also describes Dark Binding (Q) as leaving 'the pool' — that's Tormented Shadow's (W) damage zone, not the Q root, a template bleed across abilities.
audit.why: enemyKit gives Dark Binding a flat 10s cooldown and Black Shield 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s; neither ability creates a pool.
audit.corrected: Cited real cooldowns (10s Q, 26-16s E) and replaced the pool reference with the accurate 'absorbs damage and CC until broken' behavior.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: Save Prismatic Barrier for her Soul Shackles chain — one cast neutralizes the stun and buys your ADC out clean

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Soul Shackles chains everyone nearby — spread from your ADC so one cast can't stun your whole duo.

edits.before: Commit on Dark Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Dark Binding’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. It writes your spacing rules. - W Prismatic Barrier is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Dark Binding (Q) is a flat 10s cooldown — bait it with a fake step and punish the miss immediately. Black Shield (E) is 26s at rank 1, down to 16s at max, and absorbs damage as well as CC until broken, so burst it down before you commit your root.

edits.before: Level 3 your poke chunks her even through Black Shield.
edits.after: Level 3 you out-range her; bait Black Shield empty first.

edits.before: Through 3-6 your E poke shreds her even through Black Shield (which blocks CC, not damage), and your instant level-6 R punishes any Q whiff or Soul Shackles approach from a safe distance.
edits.after: Through 3-6 you out-range her; Black Shield (E) blocks damage and CC until broken — break it first, and your instant level-6 R punishes any Q whiff or Soul Shackles approach from range.

edits.before: With mana and Luden's you out-poke her all game — her Black Shield (E) blocks one root but your E and auto damage still chunk through it.
edits.after: With mana and Luden's you out-poke her all game — Black Shield (E) blocks your root and damage until it breaks, so burst it down first.

edits.before: Your 54% win rate holds late: instant long-range burst beats her melee-range engage ult, and even a shielded carry still takes full damage from your E and R.
edits.after: Late your instant long-range burst beats her melee-range engage ult; just break Black Shield with your E poke first, since it blocks damage too until it does.

edits.before: Poke with E through her Black Shield since it only stops CC, not damage
edits.after: Poke with E to break her Black Shield before you commit your Q root

notes: Black Shield error was systemic across five fields (whys, mid, spikes, late, wants.you) — all repeated the same wrong claim that it blocks CC but not damage, when Riot's own text says it absorbs both until broken. wants.foe[1] ('Pre-shield the ADC ... to negate your Q root') was already correct and left alone. missingInteractions anti-heal note (Soul Siphon/Tormented Shadow sustain) already covered adequately by existing breakdown.feeding/itemization context; no game-changing gap found there worth a length-constrained edit.
